LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.label: <color=#FFB25C>Ascendant Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash.descripti: Mingyuan becomes a pale ascendant flame, crosses up to 150 cells without line of sight, leaves a 3-cell-wide burning trail for 15 seconds, deals 10 burn damage, applies 30 Life Burn layers, knocks enemies back, and stuns them for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.label: <color=#FFD37A>Instant Combustion</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion.descriptio: Mingyuan releases a 30-cell flash of pale fire. Hostile pawns take 1 burn damage to the brain and each eye, their Life Burn layers are doubled or seeded, and they are stunned for 12 seconds. Warmup: 3 seconds. Cooldown: 18 hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.label: <color=#FF7A45>Burning Pillar</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillar.description: Place a burning core that grows from radius 1 to 15 over 10 minutes and lasts 3 hours. The edge cuts harder while the center burns harder; burn damage adds Life Burn layers. Buildings take 33% of maximum hit points per pulse. After 10 minutes the core can be ordered to move.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurn.description: Burn a pawn's biological age down to zero over 1 hour; when the age reaches zero the pawn dies. Mechanoids collapse into steel and plasteel. Buildings are dissolved into 100% of their raw materials. Warmup: 8 seconds. Cooldown: 48 hours.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Ashes of Self</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf.description: Spend all shield energy, or 50% blood if the shield cannot pay, to gain 100 Self Burn layers and open a 5x5 ashes field for 15 seconds. The field follows Mingyuan, pulses every 0.5 seconds, deals 1 burn damage, and adds Life Burn. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
